thesis: Goblin Grenade turns the tribe’s smallest creature into five damage for one mana, rewarding decks that can treat a Goblin as both attacker and ammunition.

competitiveTimeline.significance: From Fallen Empires tribal decks to Modern and Pauper Goblins, Grenade became the defining payoff for turning creature density into burn reach.

playbook.role: Hold the Grenade until sacrifice value is low or the five damage is decisive. Sequence around countermagic because losing the spell after sacrificing a creature creates a severe two-for-one.
